description:
At origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`, same-World source redefinition is live, while `StructExpectationMap` remains append-only. A superseded body can therefore poison a later `defstruct` redefinition.

## Reproducer

Run as one `Compiler2` instance:

1. Submit `Point` v1 with `defstruct [:x]` and `User.run` returning `%Point{x: 1}`; root `User.run` resolves.
2. Submit `User` v2 whose `run` returns `2`; it resolves.
3. Submit `Point` v2 with `defstruct [:y]` and `get` returning `%Point{y: 3}`; add root `Point.get`.

Actual: `Unresolved` after the Point definition fails on the stale `x` obligation. A control whose v1 User body never referenced `x` resolves.

## Root cause

`StructExpectationMap` records `(target module, field, InterfaceRequester { code, module, span })` by append/dedup only. Redefinition replaces the requester's live body facts but never replaces its expectation contribution; `validate_struct_field_expectations` checks every historical entry against the new schema.

The original ticket's "cannot fire today" premise is obsolete: current main explicitly supports and tests same-World redefinition through fresh CodeIds.

## Goal

Make expectations owned, replaceable contributions of the source/definition job that derived them, so a concluded redefinition withdraws omitted obligations while waits preserve standing ones. Do not generation-filter blindly; follow scheduler conclude-replaces/wait-extends ownership semantics.

Do not assume all three expectation stores share one live defect. The bare module-reference store deliberately preserves unresolved-diagnostic provenance today, and an import-only removal probe remained resolved because module surfaces are additive. Fold stores only if concrete lifecycle/settlement behavior proves they match.

## TDD / acceptance

- Pin the three-step redefinition reproducer and its no-old-reference control.
- Keep an error when User v2 still references `x`.
- With two requesters, retract only the dropped requester's obligation.
- Preserve out-of-order reference-before-struct validation and reference-span diagnostics.
- Census `ModuleInterface.expectations` and bare module-reference provenance under concrete redefinition reproducers; fold only on proven shared semantics, otherwise document their separate ownership.
- Focused redefinition/struct tests, full library/CLI/matrix, formatting, and strict clippy pass.
title: [BUG] Retract requester-owned struct-field expectations when live redefinition drops the reference
